flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (reminder query RD1-DR3, refreshContactInfo, validateContactInfo, combineNotices, sendBatchSms), schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, controllers/NotificationSmsEmailController, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, workflows/agencies/toppan/download/jobs/ToppanDownloadJob (stage DR3 -> CPC), cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi: notice_creation/core/helpers/NoticeProcessingHelper (UPL type X notices start at DN1). Other repos: no code specific to this story.
note: Status in stories.json: Requirement given - Gen flow; demo_remark: 'Ask Rafif if this function is ready' (readiness not confirmed). This is the UPL-offender version of OCMS11.44. The SMS flow for an individual offender after the 3rd letter (last stage DR3) exists: candidates come from the reminder query, notices of the same person are merged per stage and due date, template DR3_SMS_INDIVIDUAL (or _COMBINED), then sent in batches (max 1000 in prod) through APIM Postman2 with source ENOTIFICATION. Not active according to the repo: the eNotification scheduler is skipped (cron.notification.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:236) and in prod sms.enable=false without sms.allowedSources (application-prod.properties:87), so SmsUtil refuses to send; OCMS-DF-2026-180 (ENA, status Closed) still waits for the eNotification cron to be activated. One thing to watch: when a template is not found, the record is left out of the batch but the job still saves a notification row with status S (sent) if other batches succeed or the batch is empty (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1563-1567, 1587-1588; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:374; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:705), so a notice can be logged as sent when it was not. The template text lives in the DB (ocms_template_store), not in the repo. The mobile comes from the stored number because the DataHive refresh is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false). OCMS-SR-2026-185 states that UPL processing logic has not been developed in OCMS. SMS permission for the App Service, the real server values and DOS cannot verify from repo. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is not used as evidence.
recommendation: Claim partially. Batch SMS code for the reminder after the 3rd letter exists, but the eNotification job and SMS sending are switched off in prod, the template text is not provable from the repo, and a missing template can be logged as sent. Ask URA to confirm the activation date, the DR3 template text, and the readiness of the function (the 'Ask Rafif' remark).

steps.step: OCMS obtains the offender's mobile number from the data source (DOS)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and refreshContactInfo for every record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). refreshContactInfo only reaches DataHive when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true'; otherwise it uses the stored number and only normalises the individual's mobile (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2461-2478). The flag is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). The active path exists: refreshIndividualContactInfo reads the Singpass view in DataHive, rejects a contact shorter than 8 characters ('Invalid mobile format'), then writes the new number to ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver through updateOcmsContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2770, 2800-2823). The candidate query uses offender_indicator = 'Y' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1112), so the current offender is the one checked. The origin of the stored number for a UPL offender cannot verify from repo (the only writers of offender_tel_no visible in the repo are furnish and PLUS owner-driver). The story names DOS; DataHive = DOS cannot verify from repo. Same verdict as OCMS13.16 and OCMS11.44.

steps.step: OCMS identifies the unique individual offenders per batch and merges their outstanding notices into one SMS
steps.detail: combineNotices merges notices by the recipient key I_<id_no> + stage + due date, sums amount_payable and fills combinedNotices (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2227, key at 2178; called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191). Only individual offenders enter the SMS batch: companies are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:269-277; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1538-1546), records in the exclusion list or with a passport are removed before the batch is built (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:222-241), and records without phoneNo or with a contactError are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:252-266). Partial because the key includes the due date, so one offender with notices on different due dates gets more than one SMS, and there is no phone-number dedup across different people. The exclusion list content is DB data: cannot verify from repo. Same verdict as OCMS11.44.

steps.step: The SMS lists the outstanding notices and refers to the 3rd letter reminder
steps.detail: For a reminder, nextProcessingStage is filled with the last stage (DR3), so the chosen template is DR3_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or DR3_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-180; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:459-476). The template data holds noticeNo, combinedNotices, noticeCount, amountPayable and a paymentDueDate computed from the letter date + POS + PDD (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:410-437, 1076-1100). The query only takes notices that are not suspended (except TS-HST); there is no direct payment check in the query. The template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB) and is not seeded in the repo, so whether the message lists the outstanding notices and refers to the 3rd letter cannot verify from repo. There is a gap: a missing template makes the record be left out of the batch with an error log (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:274-312, 1563-1567), yet sendBatchSms returns true when the batch is empty (1587-1588) and the job sets smsSent = batchSmsStatus (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:374), after which the notification row is saved with the default status S (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:705). As a result a notice without a template can be logged as sent and is not selected again for the same stage during the retryDays window.

steps.step: The reminder SMS is sent to the offender in the batch job
steps.detail: The job sends through sendBatchSms: GSM-7 validation, batches of at most sms.batch.size.limit (1000 in prod), a call to smsUtil.sendBatchSmsSimple with source ENOTIFICATION, then polling of the batch status (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-292; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1527-1650). However the scheduler is skipped when cron.notification.enabled=false (NotificationJobsScheduler.java:48-53), and the value is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236). In prod sms.enable=false without sms.allowedSources (application-prod.properties:87), so SmsUtil.sendBatchSms returns status disabled (SmsUtil.java:401-410); sendBatchSms then marks every record E and sends a failure email (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1617-1633). OCMS-DF-2026-180 still waits for the eNotification cron to be activated. The job can still be triggered manually (POST /v1/notification-sms-email/execute), but the SMS is still refused while sms.enable=false. SMS permission for the App Service, APIM and the real server values cannot verify from repo.
